## Statistical methodology

- **N:** 300 questions (150 FinQA test + 150 TAT-QA dev).
- **Bootstrap CIs:** B=10,000 paired resamples of question indices (seed=42); percentile method; 95% CI.
- **McNemar exact test:** applied to binary Exact Match outcomes per contrast.
- **Paired permutation test:** sign-flip on per-question F1 differences; B=10,000 permutations.
- **Multiple-comparison correction:** Holm–Bonferroni across all five C1–C5 contrasts jointly within each metric.
- **Forest plots:** `reports/forest_C1.png` through `reports/forest_C5.png`.

## Interpretation

After Holm–Bonferroni correction across all five pre-registered contrasts, 10 contrast–metric combination(s) are significant at α=0.05:

- **C1 (base vs rag, exact match):** Δ=+0.1033, 95% CI [+0.0700, +0.1400], mcnemar_exact, p_adj=0.0000
